= HTTP and WebSocket clients

HTTP and WebSocket client libraries for making network requests from JavaScript
and Node.js.

* https://axios-http.com/[Axios]
* https://github.com/googleapis/gaxios[gaxios]
* https://github.com/sindresorhus/ky[ky]
* https://github.com/node-modules/urllib[urllib]
* https://elbywan.github.io/wretch/[wretch]
* https://undici.nodejs.org/#/[undici]
* https://github.com/sindresorhus/got[got]
* https://github.com/node-fetch/node-fetch[node-fetch]
* https://github.com/request/request[request]
* https://github.com/nodejs/undici[undici]
* https://github.com/ethanent/phin[phin]
* https://github.com/websockets/ws[ws]
* https://github.com/vpulim/node-soap[node-soap]
* https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Socket.IO[Socket.IO]
